plans.label: Plan 1
plans.rationale: Sound pacing, zones, available days and 45:00 target realism, but week 3 spikes to 441 min with a 128-min long run versus 68-min history and 83–94-min weekday sessions above the 60-min limit, risking injury. Contradictory numbers (titles vs descriptions, 242-min peak vs 272 listed) confuse the athlete.
